videos.title: Mar Radio Alba
videos.description: Tha BBC Radio nan Gaidheal mar BBC Radio Alba. BBC Radio nan Gaidheal joins BBC Radio Scotland.

videos.title: Spòrs na Seachdain
videos.description: Spòrs ionadail, nàiseanta agus bho air feadh an t-saoghail còmhla ri Iain Moireasdan. Local, national and international sport presented by John Morrison.

videos.title: Fàilt' air an Dùthaich
videos.description: Taghadh de ceòl dùthchail bho na 50an 's na 60an bho leithid Bobby Bare, Connie Smith 's tòrr eile. Country music from the 50s and 60s from Bobby Bare, Connie Smith and many more.

videos.title: Gleus
videos.description: Fuinn, còisirean agus òrain bho shaoghal ceòl clasaigeach agus eile, le Iain Moireach. Melodies, choirs and songs from the world of classical music and beyond with John Murray.

videos.title: Fonn
videos.description: Prògram de cheòl Ceilteach ùr à Alba is Èirinn le Dónall Mac Ruairí agus Joy Dunlop. New Celtic music from Scotland and Ireland.

videos.title: Mar Radio Alba
videos.description: Tha BBC Radio nan Gaidheal mar BBC Radio Alba. BBC Radio nan Gaidheal joins BBC Radio Scotland.

videos.title: Dèanamaid Adhradh
videos.description: Seirbheis còmhla ris an Urr Tormod MacÌomhair bho Eaglais na h-Alba. Gaelic religious service conducted by Rev Norman MacIver, Church of Scotland.

videos.title: Seinneamaid a Chliù
videos.description: Taghadh de laoidhean is sailm a chaidh a chruinneachadh airson Bliadhna nan Òran. A selection of hymns and psalms selected from the Bliadhna nan Òran / Year of Gaelic Song project.

videos.title: Rogha is Tagha
videos.description: Taghadh à prògraman na seachdain air a thoirt thugaibh le Anna Nic na Ceardaich. A selection from the week's programmes with Anne Sinclair.

videos.title: Crùnluath
videos.description: Eòghann MacEunraig le taghadh de cheòl na pìoba. Ewen Henderson presents a selection of pipe music.

videos.title: Gleus
videos.description: Fuinn, còisirean agus òrain bho shaoghal ceòl clasaigeach agus eile, le Iain Moireach. Melodies, choirs and songs from the world of classical music and beyond with John Murray.

videos.title: SpeakGaelic
videos.description: Podcast do luchd-ionnsachaidh na Gàidhlig ceangailte ris an t-sreath SpeakGaelic air BBC ALBA. Weekly podcast for Gaelic learners, accompanying the BBC ALBA series SpeakGaelic.

videos.title: An Litir Bheag
videos.description: Litir Bheag na seachdain sa le Ruairidh MacIlleathain. Litir àireamh 1124. This week's short letter for Gàidhlig learners.

videos.title: SpeakGaelic Extra
videos.description: Podcast do luchd-ionnsachaidh na Gàidhlig ceangailte ris an t-sreath SpeakGaelic air BBC ALBA. Weekly podcast for Gaelic learners, accompanying the BBC ALBA series SpeakGaelic.

videos.title: Litir do Luchd-ionnsachaidh
videos.description: Litir do Luchd-ionnsachaidh le Ruairidh MacIlleathain. Litir àireamh 1428. Roddy Maclean reads this week's letter for Gàidhlig learners.

videos.title: Fonn
videos.description: Prògram de cheòl Ceilteach ùr à Alba is Èirinn le Dónall Mac Ruairí agus Joy Dunlop. New Celtic music from Scotland and Ireland.

videos.title: Dèanamaid Adhradh
videos.description: Seirbheis còmhla ris an Urr Tormod MacÌomhair bho Eaglais na h-Alba. Gaelic religious service conducted by Rev Norman MacIver, Church of Scotland.

videos.title: Soillsich
videos.description: Sgeulachdan os-nàdarra mun deamhan à tasglann BBC Radio nan Gàidheal. Supernatural stories about the devil from the BBC Radio nan Gàidheal archive.

videos.title: Mar Radio Alba
videos.description: Tha BBC Radio nan Gaidheal mar BBC Radio Alba. BBC Radio nan Gaidheal joins BBC Radio Scotland.

videos.title: Dèanamaid Adhradh Tasglann
videos.description: Seirbheis à tasglann a' BhBC bho 2003 còmhla ris an Urr Seumas Dòmhnallach, Eaglais na h-Alba. Gaelic religious archive service with Rev James MacDonald, Church of Scotland 2003.

videos.title: Rogha is Tagha
videos.description: Taghadh à prògraman na seachdain air a thoirt thugaibh le Anna Nic na Ceardaich. A selection from the week's programmes with Anne Sinclair.

videos.title: Mar Radio Alba
videos.description: ha BBC Radio nan Gaidheal mar BBC Radio Alba. BBC Radio nan Gaidheal joins BBC Radio Scotland.

videos.title: Aithris na Maidne
videos.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach madainn. Local, national and international news each morning.

videos.title: Naoi gu Deich
videos.description: Còmhradh, deasbad, cultar agus cur-seachadan. Conversation, discussion, culture and lifestyle.

videos.title: A' Mire ri Linda
videos.description: Tha Linda NicLeòid a' dol gar cuir ann an sunnd le taghadh de dh'òrain agus ceòl traidiseanta Gàidhlig. Linda Macleod presents a great choice of traditional Gaelic music.

videos.title: Feasgar an-diugh
videos.description: Naidheachdan, còmhradh, spòrs, ceòl agus fealla-dhà le Niall Iain Dòmhnallach. News, chat, sport, music and entertainment with Niall Iain Macdonald.

videos.title: Caithream Ciùil
videos.description: Ceòl Ceilteach agus fiosrachadh air na tha dol agaibhse. Gaelic and Celtic music and a round-up of what's on. Post-d - dethadol@bbc.co.uk.

videos.title: Soillsich
videos.description: Sgeulachdan os-nàdarra mu thaibhsean à tasglann BBC Radio nan Gàidheal. Supernatural stories about ghosts from the BBC Radio nan Gàidheal archive.

videos.title: Fàilt' air an Dùthaich
videos.description: Taghadh de cheòl dùthchail bho na 70an agus na 80an le Marie NicMhathain. A choice of country music from the 70s and 80s with Marie Matheson.

videos.title: Aithris an Fheasgair
videos.description: Naidheachdan nàiseanta is ionadail. Local, national and international news.

videos.title: Siubhal gu Seachd le Pluto
videos.description: Ceòl, fealla-dhà agus sùil air spòrs ionadail, nàiseanta agus eadar-nàiseanta. Music and entertainment with Derek Pluto Murray along with his Musical Links. Tweet @DerekPluto.

videos.title: Cruinn
videos.description: Ceòl, amaideas 's na beachdan agaibh air cuspairean a' là airson ur cuir ann a sunnd airson na seachdain. Music, opinion and general nonsense to get your week off to a good start.

videos.title: Fad Botal Fion
videos.description: Bho AI gu caraidean: cò às a thàinig a' chomhairle as miosa? Taking advice is easy. Knowing when to ignore it is the hard part.

videos.title: A' Mire ri Linda
videos.description: Tha Linda NicLeòid a' dol gar cuir ann an sunnd le taghadh de dh'òrain agus ceòl traidiseanta Gàidhlig. Linda Macleod presents a great choice of traditional Gaelic music.
